tagline: Start, schedule, and follow up on Zoom meetings without ever leaving Slack
metaTitle: Slack Zoom Integration: Schedule Calls and Post Summaries
metaDescription: Schedule Zoom meetings from a Slack thread, drop an instant link into a discussion, and post summaries to the channel. GAIA runs it all. See the setup steps.
intro:
Slack is where team decisions get made and Zoom is where conversations happen, but the handoff between them is clunky. Scheduling a meeting from chat requires app-switching, link-sharing, and calendar juggling. When a meeting ends, the decisions and action items discussed rarely make it back into the channel where the team continues to work.

GAIA connects the two to make video meetings a native part of your Slack workflow. When a conversation requires a real-time discussion, ask GAIA to schedule a Zoom meeting, find availability, and post the link to the channel. After the meeting ends, GAIA can post a summary of the discussion and action items back to the thread so anyone who missed it is immediately caught up.

For remote and hybrid teams, this integration means the context gap between video meetings and chat work disappears. What's decided in the meeting lands back in the channel automatically, and scheduling a meeting is as easy as mentioning it in a message.

useCases.title: Schedule Zoom meetings from Slack conversations
useCases.description: When a thread reaches a point where a meeting is needed, ask GAIA to schedule a call with the thread participants. GAIA checks availability, creates the meeting, and posts the invite link back to the channel.

useCases.title: Post meeting summaries to channels
useCases.description: After a meeting ends, GAIA generates a summary of the discussion and key action items and posts it to the relevant channel so the team has a written record without needing to take manual notes.

useCases.title: Instant Zoom link for ongoing discussions
useCases.description: When a back-and-forth gets too complicated for text, ask GAIA for a quick link. GAIA generates an instant meeting link and posts it to the thread so participants can jump on a call in seconds.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting reminders by DM
useCases.description: GAIA sends DMs to meeting participants 10 minutes before scheduled calls with the meeting title, agenda, and join link, reducing no-shows without requiring calendar reminder configuration.

useCases.title: Meeting recording notifications in Slack
useCases.description: When a cloud recording is available, GAIA posts a notification in the relevant channel with a link to the recording and a text summary, ensuring everyone can access meeting content even if they missed it.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Slack workspace and Zoom account in GAIA's settings. GAIA integrates with both to coordinate scheduling, meeting creation, and post-meeting content sharing.

howItWorks.step: Define how meetings flow between the two apps
howItWorks.description: Configure which channels can trigger meeting scheduling, how post-meeting summaries should be formatted, and which channels receive recording notifications. Set preferences in plain language.

howItWorks.step: Meetings and chat work together automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA handles scheduling from chat, posting meeting context, and routing post-meeting content back to the right channels. The gap between meeting discussions and daily work closes automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA start an instant Zoom meeting from a Slack command?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA in any channel or DM to start a meeting immediately. GAIA creates the meeting and posts the join link, no calendar scheduling required.

faqs.question: Does GAIA use transcripts for meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: When cloud transcription is enabled on your account (available on Business plans and above), GAIA uses the actual transcript to generate accurate meeting summaries. For accounts without transcription, GAIA generates summaries from meeting metadata and any notes shared.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post the summary to a specific channel rather than where it was scheduled?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to post summaries to a dedicated #meeting-notes channel, the channel where the meeting was scheduled, or both. You can also request a specific channel at scheduling time.

faqs.question: Does this work for recurring meetings?
faqs.answer: GAIA can schedule recurring meetings from a request in chat and post summaries after each occurrence. For recurring meetings, GAIA tracks each session separately and posts summaries to the designated channel after every meeting.
